dataset.name: Google Borg ClusterData2019 plus May 2019 power traces
dataset.description: Planned joint workload/power trace candidate. Official repository describes eight Borg cells in May 2019 and power traces for 57 power domains over the same month. Domain mapping, power-value semantics, exact file set and attribution are unverified; not an AI-only or GPU/facility-meter benchmark by assumption.

license_gate.review_note: The repository README states trace data/documentation are CC-BY, but the exact release files, attribution requirements and distribution terms must be reviewed before retrieval or redistribution.

time_scope.notes: ClusterData2019 covers May 2019, but chosen file-level time origins, units, aggregation granularity, power/workload clock alignment and time zone must be verified against official schema and power documentation. Do not assume row-number alignment or one-to-one cell/domain mapping.

field_mappings.notes: Candidate workload field; exact table, event semantics and timestamp origin remain unverified.
Do not infer AI/GPU demand or useful-work units from generic resource fields without a documented mapping.
Must verify power trace identifiers and any mapping to cells/machines; no one-to-one correspondence is assumed.
Exact power or energy unit, sample interval, semantics (metered/derived/normalized) and attribution class must be established from the source documentation.

workload_quality.notes: Borg cluster workload traces are not inherently AI inference-quality or endpoint SLO traces. Quality-accepted AI work/kWh must remain unsupported absent a separate named model/dataset quality gate.

energy_attribution.notes: Power traces are a promising paired source but values have not been inspected. Do not call them metered facility power or infer GPU energy before verifying source semantics, domains and measurement boundary.

data_quality.notes: No artifacts retrieved. File-level row counts, timestamp continuity, duplicates, sentinels, missingness and workload-to-power alignment are not yet known.

transformation.normalization_notes: No download or transformation has run. Pin exact raw files and SHA-256 digests, then document parser version/config and normalized artifact digest.

allowed_claims: The official Google Borg trace repository is registered as a candidate workload-plus-power source.
The next step is format, license/attribution, power-boundary and workload-to-domain mapping review.
